Current Assets excluding Cash & Short Term Investments - Total [SCACS] represents the value of all current assets (Total Current Assets [STCA]) less total value of cash on hand and short term deposits due from other banks (Cash & Short Term Investments - Total [SCSTI]. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies. (Used for analytics)

Cash, Short Term Investments & Accounts Receivable - Total [SCSAR] represents the sum of the total value of cash on hand and short term deposits due from other banks. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Cash, Short Term Investments & Accounts Receivable - Total [SCSAR] includes:
• Cash & Short Term Investments - Total [SCSTI]
• Trade Accounts & Trade Notes Receivable - Net – Total [SAACR] (Used for analytics)

Short-Term Investments - Total [SSTI] represents investments in debt and equity securities & derivaties with maturity of one year or less. Applicable to Industrial & Property.
Short-Term Investments - Total [SSTI] includes:
• Derivative Financial Instruments - Speculative/Trading - Short-Term [ATDV]
• Short-Term Investments [ASTI]
• Derivative Financial Instruments - Speculative/Trading in Receivables - Short-Term [ATDR]
• Islamic Investments & Deposits [ISID]
• Islamic Investments & Deposits - Short-Term [ISIDS]
• Financial Assets - Short-Term [SFAC]

Restricted Accounts - Short-Term [SRCA] represents cash on hand and other assets that bear some kind of restriction and may not be available for operational use by the company. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Restricted Accounts - Short-Term [SRCA] Includes:
• Restricted Accounts - Short-Term [ARCA]
• Restricted Investment - Short-Term [ARSI]

Property, Plant & Equipment - excluding Assets Leased Out - Net - Total [SPXE] represent the net value of all tangible fixed assets excluding assets leased out. Applicable to Industrial and Financial companies.
Property, Plant & Equipment - excluding Assets Leased Out - Net - Total  [SPXE] includes:
• Land & Buildings - Net [SLSN]
• Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Net [SMEN]
• Construction in Progress - Net [SCPN]
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Under Capital Lease - Net [SPCN]
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total/Unspecified - Net [SRTN]
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Net [SOPN]

Property, Plant & Equipment - excluding Assets Leased Out - Gross [SPXC] represents the value of fixed assets other than assets leased out before depreciation and impairment. Applicable to Industrial and Financial companies.  
Property, Plant & Equipment - excluding Assets Leased Out - Gross [SPXC] includes:
• Land & Buildings - Gross [SLSC]
• Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Gross [SMEC]
• Construction in Progress - Gross [SCPC]
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Under Capital Lease - Gross [SCLC]
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total/Unspecified - Gross [SRTC]
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Gross [SOPC]

Land & Buildings - Gross [SLSC] represents the gross book value (before depreciation) of freehold land and buildings, where not shown separately. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Land & Buildings - Gross [SLSC] includes: 
• Land/Improvements - Gross [SLIC]
• Buildings - Gross [SBGC]
• Leasehold Improvements - Gross [SLEC]
• Land & Buildings - Gross [ALSC]

Leasehold Improvements - Gross [SLEC] represents gross book value (before depreciation) of improvements made to real estate held or leased out under operating lease/rental agreements. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Leasehold Improvements - Gross [SLEC] includes:
• Leasehold Improvements - Gross [ALEC]

Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Gross [SMEC] represents gross book value (before depreciation and impairment)  of plant, machinery and other equipment. It includes machines and machine parts needed by the company to produce its products. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Gross [SMEC] includes: 
• Transportation Equipment - Gross [STEC]
• Computer Software & Equipment - Gross [SSCS]
• Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Gross [AMEC]

Computer Software & Equipment - Gross [SSCS] represents the gross book value (before depreciation) of computer equipment and the information a computer uses to perform tasks. Is used when computer software and equipment is reported within PPE. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Computer Software & Equipment - Gross [SSCS] includes:
• Computer Software & Equipment - Tangible Assets - Gross [ASCS]

Construction in Progress - Gross [SCPC] represents the gross book value (before depreciation) carried forward of capital work in progress and other tangible fixed assets under construction. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Construction in Progress - Gross [SCPC] includes:
• Construction in Progress - Gross [ACPC]

Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total - Gross [SRTC] The total gross value of right-of-use tangible assets held under any leasing contracts, before the deduction of depreciation, amortization or impairment allowances. Also used when it's impossible to determine if the company holds assets under operating or financial leases. Financial lease codes should be used for IFRS reports. Applicable to all Industries.
Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total - Gross [SRTC] includes:
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Gross [SROG]
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Capital/Finance Lease - Gross [SRFG]

Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Gross [SROG] represents the gross value of the right to control the use of property, plant and equipment held under operating lease contracts, before the deduction of depreciation, amortization or impairment allowances. Applicable to all Industries.
Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Gross [SROG] includes:
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Gross [AROC]

Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Gross [SOPC] represents the gross value of tangible assets other than Plant/Machinery/Equipment, Land/Buildings, Property Plant & Equipment under Capitalized Leases or Construction in Progress. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Gross [SOPC] includes:
•  Natural Resources/Biological Assets - Gross [SBAC]
•  Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Gross [SMXC]
•  Utility Plant - Gross [SUTP]
•  Property, Plant & Equipment - Contra Item - Gross [SCCP] (deducted)
•  Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Gross [AOPC]

Property, Plant & Equipment - excluding Assets Leased Out - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment - Total [SDPX] represents the accumulated depreciation  and impairment of fixed assets other than assets leased out. Applicable to Industrial and Other Financial companies.
Property, Plant & Equipment - excluding Assets Leased Out - Gross - Total [SDPX] includes:
• Land & Buildings - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDLS]
• Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDME]
• Construction in Progress - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDCP]
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Under Capital Lease - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDLC]
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total/Unspecified - Accumulated Depreciation [SRTD]
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDPZ]

Restricted Accounts - Long-Term [SRCL] refers to cash, investments and other assets whose use is limited by law or other regulations, and permitted in more than one year or long-term in nature. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Restricted Accounts - Long-Term [SRCL] includes:
• Restricted Cash - Long-Term [ARCL]

Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable [SSOD] refers to short term debt, notes payable, bills of exchange and other interest-bearing debt obligations due within a year. Applicable to all industries.
Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable [SSOD] includes:
Industrial and Property:
•  Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable [LSOD]
•  Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable - Financial Sector [LSODF]
•  Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable - Negative [LNSD]
•  Bills of Exchange & Notes [LBLS]
•  Short-Term Debt & Current Portion of Long-Term Debt [XSTD]
•  Short-Term Debt & Current Portion of Long-Term Debt - Negative [XNSD]
•  Short-Term Debt & Current Portion of Long-Term Debt - Financial Sector [XSTDF]
•  Financial Liabilities - Short-Term [LFCR] (if there are no other debt items)

Bank, Insurance, Investment and Financial companies additionally includes:
•  Short-Term Banking Borrowings excluding Collateralized Financing [SDXF]
•  Collateralized Financing Agreements, REPO Financing Loans - Liabilities [SAFL]

Operating Lease Liabilities - Current Portion/Short-Term [SSOL] represents the total current operating lease liabilities, including the current portion of long-term operating leases and short-term accrued operating lease costs. Includes current operating lease liabilities reported by a company's financing arm. Applicable to all Industries.
Operating Lease Liabilities - Current Portion/Short-Term [SSOL] includes:
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Current Portion/Short-Term [LSOL]
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Current Portion/Short-Term - Financial Sector [LSOLF]
• Lease Liabilities - Unspecified - Current Portion/Short-Term [LSLU]

Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term [SLOL] represents the total long-term operating lease liabilities. Includes long-term operating lease liabilities reported by a company's financing arm. Applicable to all Industries.
Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term [SLOL] includes:
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term [LLOL]
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term - Financial Sector [LLOLF]
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term & Short-Term [LTOL]
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term & Short-Term - Financial Sector [LTOLF]
• Lease Liabilities - Unspecified - Long -Term [LLLU]
• Lease Liabilities - Unspecified - Long-Term & Short-Term [LTLU]

Preferred Shareholders Equity [SPSE] represents the total preferred shareholders. It includes preferred stock owned by the issuing company or its consolidated subsidiaries and other preferred stock. Applicable to all industries.
Preferred Shareholders Equity [SPSE] includes: 
• Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Total [SRPS]
• Preferred Stock - Non-Redeemable [SNRP]
• Preferred Equity - Contributed [SCPF]
• Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Temporary Equity [STPR]
• ESOP Guarantees - Preferred & Deferred Compensation [SEDP]
• Preferred Stock - Treasury/Repurchased [STSP] (deducted)
• Preferred Shareholders Equity - Total [QPSU]

Preferred Equity - Contributed [SCPF] includes:
• Preferred Stock - Other [QPRS]
• Preferred Capital - Equity Component [ZPSL]
• Preferred Stock - Liquidation Excess [QLXP]
• Preferred Stock - Carrying Value (Equity) [QVPE]
• Liquidation & Redemption Value of Non-Redeemable Preferred Stock (Equity) [QLRE]
• Liquidation & Redemption Value of Redeemable Preferred Stock (Equity) [QLRR]
• Preferred Stock - Capital Surplus [QPFS]
• Preferred Stock - Issued for ESOP [QEDQ]
Applicable to all Industries.

Common Shares - Authorized - Issue Specific [STCAI] represents the number of common shares authorized for issuance in addition to the current stock (per specific share issues - instrument level). Applicable to all Industries.
Common Shares - Authorized - Issue Specific [STCAI] includes:
• Common Shares - Authorized - Issue Specific [XTCAI]

Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total - Net - Supplemental [SRTNS] represents gross Right of use assets less accumulated depreciation. Disclosed based on the adoption of IFRS 16/ASC 842 -Leases. Applicable to all industries.
Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total - Net - Supplemental [SRTNS] includes:
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Net - Supplemental [SRONS]
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Capital/Finance Lease - Net - Supplemental [SRFNS]

In absence of the above, it includes:
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total/Unspecified - Net [ARTN]
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total/Unspecified - Gross [ARTC]
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total/Unspecified - Accumulated Depreciation [ADTR] (Deducted).

Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Net - Supplemental [SRONS] represents gross Operating Right of use assets Less accumulated depreciation. Disclosed based on the adoption of IFRS 16/ASC 842 -Leases. Applicable to all industries.
Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Net - Supplemental [SRONS] includes:
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Net [ARON]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Gross [AROC]
• Less Right of Use Tangible Assets - Operating Lease - Accumulated Depreciation [ADRO] (Deducted).

Property, Plant & Equipment - excluding Right of Use Tangible Assets & Capital Leases - Net - Supplemental [SPXR] represents Property, Plant & Equipment Net excluding Right of use assets. Applicable to all industries.
Property, Plant & Equipment - excluding Right of Use Tangible Assets & Capital Leases - Net - Supplemental [SPXR] includes:
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Net - Total [SPPE]
• Right of Use Tangible Assets - Total - Net - Supplemental (deducted)
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Under Capital Lease - Net [SPCN] (deducted)

Total Operating Lease Liabilities - Supplemental [STLT] represents total long-term accrued rental liabilities arising from operating lease contracts. Applicable to all Industries.
Total Operating Lease Liabilities - Supplemental[STLT] includes:
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term & Short-Term - Supplemental [SOLZS]
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Current Portion/Short-Term - Supplemental [SSOLS]
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term - Supplemental [SLOLS]

Operating Lease Liabilities - Current Portion/Short-Term - Supplemental [SSOLS] represents current or short term portion of Operating lease liabilities, disclosed based on the adoption of IFRS 16/ASC 842 -Leases. Applicable to all industries.
Operating Lease Liabilities - Current Portion/Short-Term - Supplemental [SSOLS] includes:
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Current Portion/Short-Term [LSOL]
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Current Portion/Short-Term - Financial Sector [LSOLF]
• Lease Liabilities - Unspecified - Current Portion/Short-Term [LSLU]

Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term - Supplemental [SLOLS] represents total long term operating lease liabilities, disclosed based on the adoption of IFRS 16/ASC 842 -Leases. Applicable to all industries.
Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term - Supplemental [SLOLS] includes:
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term [LLOL]
• Operating Lease Liabilities - Long-Term - Financial Sector [LLOLF]
• Lease Liabilities - Unspecified - Long -Term [LLLU]

Finance and Operating Lease Liabilities - Total - Supplemental [STFL] represents the sum of operating lease liabilities and capital leases arising on adoption of IFRS 16. Applicable to all Industries.
Finance and Operating Lease Liabilities - Total - Supplemental [STFL] includes: 
• Total Operating Lease Liabilities - Supplemental [STLT]
• Capitalized Leases - Current Portion [SCFL]
• Capitalized Lease Obligations - Long-Term [SLCL]

Investments - Total [STIV] represents total of trading, term, property & other investments and Loans, applied under non-differentiated method. Applicable to Industrial, Bank, Property, Investment & other financial.
Investments - Total [STIV] includes:
• Investment Property [SVPT]
• Investment Securities - Available for Sale, Held to Maturity & Held for Trading - Total [STIS]
• Investments - Other - Total [STIO]
• Commodities [SCMD] (For investments)
• Investments - Other - Total [STIO] (For investments)
• FHLB Stock - Asset [SFHA] (For Banks)
• Investments - Private Equity & Other - Total [SPES] (For Other Financials)

Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term (Years) - Operating Lease - US GAAP [SVWOY] represents the average remaining lifespan of the Lease liability. The lessee discloses the Weighted average Remaining lease term calculated based on the remaining lease term and the lease liability balance for each lease as of the reporting date. The data item is disclosed under the lease footnote for Operating leases reported under US GAAP. Applicable to all industries.

Weighted Average Discount Rate - Operating Lease - US GAAP [SWODR] requires the lessee to calculate based on the discount rate used to calculate the lease liability balance and the remaining balance of the lease payments for each lease as of the balance sheet date. The data item is disclosed under the lease footnote for Operating leases reported under US GAAP. Applicable to all industries.

Investments - Long-Term [SILT] represents the total value of long-term investments held for sale or to maturity including investment property and other non-current financial assets. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies. 
Investments - Long-Term [SILT] includes: 
Industrial: 
• Investment Property - Net [SNVP]
• Investments - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Long-Term [SLTI]
• Financial Assets - Long-Term [SFAN]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Investment Property - Net [SNVP]
• Investments - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Long-Term [SLTI]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Investments - Long-Term - Total [XLIU].

Investments - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Long-Term [SLTI] represents total marketable securities, term, equity & other investments. Applicable to Differentiated Industrial & Property.
Investments - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Long-Term [SLTI] includes:
•  Marketable Securities - Long-Term [SMSL]
•  Investments - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Long-Term [ALTI]
•  Derivative Assets - Speculative/Trading - Long-Term [ALDS]
•  Islamic Investments & Deposits - Long-Term [ISIDL]
•  Investment Securities - Designated/Measured at Fair Value through Other Comprehensive Income (FVOCI) [ACFV]
•  Investments - Long-Term - Total [XLIU] (For Industrial)
•  Equity in Affiliates in Unconsolidated Subsidiaries [AEQA] (For Property)
•  Equity in Non-Affiliated & Non-Controlled Companies[AEQN] (For Property)
•  Investments - Other [AOIT] (For Property)
•  Investment Securities - Total [XTIS]

Marketable Securities - Long-Term [SMSL] represents long-term investments in very liquid instruments easily convertible into cash. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies. 
Marketable Securities - Long-Term [SMSL] includes:
• Marketable Securities - Long-Term [AMSL]

Deferred Charges - Long-Term [SNDC] represents the net value of deferred costs including the fuel cost which are not recognized as a cost during the period in which it is incurred. Applicable to Property and Industrial companies. 
Deferred Charges - Long-Term [SNDC] includes: 
• Deferred Costs - Net [ADFN]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Deferred Fuel Costs - Long-Term [ALDF]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Other Deferred Charges/Prepayments [AODC]

Prepaid Expenses - Long-Term [SNPY] represents prepaid expenses disclosed outside current assets and due after one year. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Prepaid Expenses - Long-Term [SNPY] includes:
• Prepaid Expenses - Long-Term [ANPY]

Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Total [SRPS] represents all redeemable preferred stock both convertible and non-convertible, and redeemable on the maturity date. Applicable to all Industries. 
Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Total [SRPS] includes:
• Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Convertible [SPRC]
• Preferred Stock - Redeemable [ZPSK]

Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Convertible [SPRC] refers to preferred stock that is convertible and redeemable at maturity. The preferred stock may be converted into common stock under certain conditions at the predetermined ratio at the option of preferred stockholders. Applicable to all Industries.
Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Convertible [SPRC] includes: 
• Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Convertible [ZCPS]

Revenue from Goods & Services [SNTS] represents the total value of receipts from the sales of products and services. The value of sales revenues after cash discounts, trade discounts, excise tax, and sales returns and allowances. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Revenue from Goods & Services [SNTS] includes:
• Sales of Goods & Services - Net - Unclassified [SNTU]
• Hotel Revenue [SHRV]
• Rental & Property-Related Operating Revenue [SRPT]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Utility Revenue - Total [SRVU]
• Sales Returns, Allowances & Other Revenue Adjustments [SSRT] (deducted)
• Revenue Taxes [SEXT] (deducted)
• Gross Revenue from Business Activities - Total [SREV]

In the absence of above, it includes: 
• Sales of Goods & Services - Net [RNTS]
• Revenue from Goods & Services [RNTU]

Sales of Goods & Services - Net - Unclassified [SNTU] represents net receipts from the sales of products and services after cash discounts, trade discounts, excise tax, and sales returns and allowances.  Applicable to Industrial, Property and Investment Trust companies.
Sales of Goods & Services - Net - Unclassified [SNTU] includes:
• Sales of Goods & Services - Net [RNTS]

Revenue from Business Activities - Total [STLR] represents total consolidated revenue of a Company. Applicable to all Industries.
Revenue from Business Activities - Total [STLR] includes:  
Industrial:
• Revenue from Goods & Services [SNTS]
• Revenue from Financing-Related Operations [SFRO]
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR]

Banks:
• Interest & Dividend Income - Net - Finance [SIDI]
• Non-Interest Business Revenue - Net - Total [SNIB]

Insurance:
• Net Premiums Earned [SPNE]
• Investment Income - Net - Insurance [SNRV]
• Investments & Loans - Business - Gain/Loss [SGIL]
• Business-Related Financing Revenue - Other [SOFB]
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR]

Property:
• Revenue from Goods & Services [SNTS]
• Revenue from Financing-Related Operations [SFRO]
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR]

Investment Trust:
• Investment Income - Gross - Investment [SGII]
• Interest & Fees on Loans [STCF]
• Investments & Loans - Business - Gain/Loss [SGIL]
• Business-Related Financing Revenue - Other [SOFB]
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR]
• Operating Revenue - Capital Account [SORC]
• Operating Revenue - Revenue Account [SOPS]

Other Financial:
• Interest & Dividend Income - Finance - Total [SIDT]
• Net Commission & Fees Income/Expense - Business Revenue [SNCF]
• Net Foreign Exchange Income - Business Revenue [SNFE]
• Investments & Loans - Business - Gain/Loss [SGIL]
• Net Income from Operating & Finance Lease - Business Revenue [SOFL]
• Business-Related Financing Revenue - Other [SOFB]
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Total Revenue [XTLR]

Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SICO] represents a sum of the income/expense after all operating and non-operating income and expense, reserves, income taxes but before equity in earnings, minority interest, extraordinary items, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations and preferred dividends (Net Income after Tax [SIAT]), the share of earnings/losses that the company is entitled to from unconsolidated affiliated companies which has not been distributed as dividends (Equity in Earnings of Affiliates (after Taxes) [SQEA]) and adjustments to net income reported after taxes but before equity in earnings, minority interest, extraordinary items, discontinued operations and preferred dividends (After-Tax Adjustments - Other - Total [SOAN]). Applicable to all Industries.
Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SICO] is the sum of:
• Equity in Earnings of Affiliates (after Taxes) [SQEA]
• After-Tax Adjustments - Other - Total [SOAN]
• Net Income after Tax [SIAT]

Net Income before Minority Interest [SIBM] represents the sum of Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SICO] and all after tax extraordinary items reported by the company (Extraordinary Activities - after Tax - Gain/Loss [STEX]). If the statement is non-detailed Net Income before Minority Interest [SIBM] is equal to Net Income after Extraordinary Items [XNIX]. Applicable to all Industries.

Net Income after Minority Interest [SNIC] represents total net income/loss reported by the company after provision for income taxes, equity in earnings, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations, extraordinary items and minority interest, but before other adjustments to net income, preferred dividends and other distributions. Applicable to all Industries.
Net Income after Minority Interest [SNIC] includes:
• Net Income before Minority Interest [SIBM]
• Minority Interest [SMNI] (Deducted)

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Net Income - including Extraordinary Items [XNIC]

Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS] represents total net income/loss reported by  the company after provision for income taxes, equity in earnings, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations, extraordinary items and minority interest, but before other adjustments to net income, preferred dividends and other distributions. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS] includes:
• Net Income after Minority Interest [SNIC*]
• Interest Expense - Hybrid Debt Instruments - Equity [SIHD] (deducted)
• Distribution for General Partners [SDSP]  (deducted)
• Distribution for Preferred Shares [SDFS]  (deducted)
• Earnings Adjustments to Net Income - Other [SOAJ] (deducted)

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Policyholders Surplus [SPHS] (deducted)

In the absence of the item [*] above it uses Net Income - including Extraordinary Items applicable to Common [XNCX].
Net Income - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [BINCC] represents Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS]. Applicable to all Industries.

Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCN] represents income before extraordinary items and preferred and common dividends, but after operating and non-operating income and expense, reserves, income taxes, minority interest and equity in earnings. Applicable to all Industries.
Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCN] is the difference between:
• Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS]
• Extraordinary Activities - after Tax - Gain/Loss [STEX]

Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Total [SBASC] represents the weighted average common shares outstanding used to calculate earnings and other per share items, at company level. Applicable to all Industries.
Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Total [SBASC] includes:
• Shares used to calculate Basic EPS [BWASC]

Alternatively if CPO is primary Instrument for the company, it is:
• Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific - CPO [BWASICPO]

EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SBAIC] represents the basic bottom line net income  available to common shareholders (Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS]) per share (Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Total [SBASC], at company level. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SBAIC] includes:
• EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [BEPSBC] (if the calculation above is not available)

EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SBCOC] represents the net income available to common shareholders, excluding extraordinary items (Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCN]) per share (Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Total [SBASC]), at company level. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SBCOC] includes:
• EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [BEPSCC] (if the calculation above is not available)

Alternatively if CPO is primary Instrument for the company, it is calculated as: 
• Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCN] /Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific - CPO [BWASICPO], or 
• EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - CPO [BEPSCICPO]

EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Total [SBESC] represents the value of Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] divided by the Number of basic weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item on company level (Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Total [SBASC]). Applicable to all industries.

EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SBAII] represents as reported basic bottom line net income (Allocated Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [BINCI]) per share (Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI]) available to common shareholders. Reported per specific share issues. Applicable to all Industries.

It uses Net Income - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [BINCC] as numerator if the account above is not available.

If calculation above is not available, it uses EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [BEPSBI].

EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SBCOI] represents as reported basic net income including all after tax items but before extraordinary items (Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCN]) per share (Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI]). Reported per specific share issues. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SBCOI] includes:
• EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [BEPSCI] (if calculation above is not available)

EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific [SBESI] represents the value of Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] divided by the number of basic weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item on instrument level (Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI]). Applicable to all industries.

EPS - Basic from Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SEPSXB] represents the basic per share of the gain/loss resulting from nonrecurring or unusual events and discontinued operations. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Basic from Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SEPSXB] is difference between: 
• EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SBAIC]
• EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SBCOC]

Net Income - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [DINCC] represents a sum of Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS] and the value of Diluted Adjustment [CDAJ]. Applicable to all Industries.

Diluted Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCND] represents Diluted net income after dilution adjustments but before After-tax extraordinary items. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Diluted Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCND] includes: 
• Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS]
• Dilution Adjustment [CDAJ]
• Extraordinary Activities - after Tax - Gain/Loss [STEX] (deducted)

Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC] represents the diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share items, at company level. Applicable to all Industries:
Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC] includes:
• Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [DWASC]

Alternatively if CPO is primary Instrument for the company, it is:
• Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific - CPO [DWASICPO]

EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDAIC] represents the diluted bottom line net income available to common shareholders (Net Income - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common [CDNI]) per share (Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC]), at company level. Applicable to all Industries.

It uses Net Income - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [DINCC] as numerator if the account above is not available.

If calculation above is not available, it uses EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [DEPSBC].

EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDCOC] represents the diluted net income available to common shareholders excluding extraordinary items (Diluted Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCND]) per share (Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC]), at company level. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDCOC] includes:
• EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [DEPSCC] (if calculation above is not available)

Alternatively if CPO is primary Instrument for the company, it is calculated as: 
• Diluted Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCND] / Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific - CPO [DWASICPO], or 
• EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - CPO [DEPSCICPO]

EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Total [SDESC] represents the value of Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] divided by the number of diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item on company level (Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC]).  Applicable to all Industries.

EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SDAII] represents as reported diluted bottom line net income available to common shareholders (Allocated Diluted Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DINCCI]) per share (Shares used to calculate EPS - Diluted - Issue Specific [SDWSI]). Reported per specific share issues. Applicable to all Industries.

It uses Net Income - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [DINCC] as numerator if the account above is not available.

If calculation above is not available, it uses EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DEPSBI].

EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SDCOI] represents as reported diluted net income including all after tax items but before extraordinary items (Diluted Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCND]) per share (Shares used to calculate EPS - Diluted - Issue Specific [SDWSI]). Reported per specific share issues. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SDCOI] includes:
• EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DEPSCI] (if calculation above is not available)

EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific [SDESI] represents the value of Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] divided by the number of diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item on instrument level (Shares used to calculate EPS - Diluted - Issue Specific [SDWSI]). Applicable to all Industries.

EPS - Diluted from Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SEPSXD] represents the diluted per share of the gain/loss resulting from nonrecurring or unusual events and discontinued operations. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Diluted from Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SEPSXD] is difference between:
• EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDAIC]
• EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDCOC]

Normalized Net Income from Continuing Operations [SNCO] represents the difference between Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SICO] and Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN]. Applicable to all Industries.

Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] represents total net income/loss reported by  the company after provision for income taxes, equity in earnings, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations, extraordinary items and minority interest, but before other adjustments to net income, preferred dividends and other distributions (Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS]) adjusted by the total value of non-recurring income or expenses (Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN]) and total after tax extraordinary items (Extraordinary Activities - after Tax - Gain/Loss [STEX]). Applicable to all Industries.

Estimated Tax Rate [SETAXV] represents the estimated taxes in the country of domicile. Calculated when the value of tax benefits relating to Stock option compensation (Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [VSCT]) is not provided. Applicable to all Industries.

Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR] represents the total cost of goods and services sold. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies. 
Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR] includes:
• Cost of Financing-Related Operations [SCFS]
• Cost of Revenues - Total [SCGS]

• Cost of Goods & Services - Total [ECGU]

• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]
• Cost of Goods & Services - Total [ECGU]

• Fees & Commissions Expense [SCFE]

• Cost of Revenues - Total [XCGS]

Cost of Revenues - Total [SCGS] represents all as reported costs of goods and services. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies. 
Cost of Revenues - Total [SCGS] includes:

Cost of Revenues - Unclassified [SCOU] represents the total cost of goods and services sold.
This is only populated if other components of Cost of Revenues - Total [SCGS] are available.
Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Cost of Revenues - Unclassified [SCOU] includes:
• Cost of Revenues[ECOR]

Amortization in Cost of Revenues [SACS] represents amortization of intangible assets included in cost of revenues. It is the accounting process of allocating the cost of assets that lack physical existence over those periods expected to benefit from the use of these assets included in cost of revenues. These assets usually have a high degree of uncertainty concerning future benefits. Applicable to Industrial, Property and Investment companies. 
Amortization in Cost of Revenues [SACS] includes:
• Premiums Earned & Other Income from Insurance - Bank - Total [EAMC]
• Amortization of Intangibles excluding Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAMX]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges in Cost of Revenues [EADC]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs in Cost of Revenues [EALC]
• Amortization of Computer Software in Cost of Revenues[EASC]

• Amortization & Impairment of Intangibles including Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAIC]
• Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development in Cost of Revenues [EARC]
• Amortization of Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAGC]

If Cost of sales is available, then it also includes:
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill [EAMI]
• Amortization of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [EALR]
• Amortization of Intangibles excluding Goodwill [EAMO]

• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs [EAML]
• Amortization of Computer Software [EASW]
• Amortization of Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles [EAMB]

Gross Profit - Industrials/Property - Total [SGRP] represents the company's residual profit after selling a product or service and deducting the cost associated with its production and sale. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Gross Profit - Industrials/Property - Total [SGRP] includes:
• Revenue from Business Activities - Total [STLR]
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR] (Deducted)
In the absence of above, it includes:
• As Reported Gross Profit [XGRP]. 
Applicable to Industrial, Property, Other Financial and Investment Trust companies.

Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Total [SSGA] represents all costs of operating a business other than the costs of readying a product for sale. Applicable to all Industries.
Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Total [SSGA] includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Unclassified [SSGU]
Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SLAS]
• Depreciation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SDES]
• Amortization of Intangibles in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SAMS]
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other - Total [SSGO]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Research & Development Expense [SRAD]
• Exploration/Dry Hole Expenses (including Write-Off) [SEXP]
• Operations & Maintenance (Utility) [SDOE]

Investment Trust companies additionally includes:
• Investment Management Fees [SIMF]

Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Unclassified [SSGU] represents all costs of operating a business other than the costs of readying a product for sale. Applicable to all Industries.
Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Unclassified [SSGU] includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ESGA]

Labor & Related Expenses including Stock-Based Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SLAS] represents expenses paid to employees of a company in the form of salaries, wages, fees, benefits or any other form of compensation reported within the selling, general and administrative expenses. It includes expenses paid to employees in the form of the company’s shares when reported within SGA. This code is also used when the company presents the I/s ‘By Nature’ for Service Organization and Utility Companies. This field should also be used when the company reports labor expenses outside cogs, SGA or with in any other expenses. Applicable to all Industries.
Labor & Related Expenses including Stock-Based Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SLAS] includes:
• Management Remuneration [EMEN]
• Workers' Profits Participation & Welfare Funds [EWPF]
• Labor & Related Expenses in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ELAS]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ESCS]

Research & Development Expense [SRAD] represents expenses for research and development of new products and services by a company in order to obtain a competitive advantage.  It represents the portion expensed during the year, and excludes the portion capitalized to tangible or intangible assets. Capitalization of research and development expenditure is rare for US companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Research & Development Expense [SRAD] includes:
• Research & Development Expense [ERAD]
• Research & Development Expense - Capitalized [ECRD] (deducted)
• Rental Expenses in Research & Development Expense [ERRD]
• Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total [ETRD]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Research & Development Expense [ESCR]
• Engineering Expenses [EENX]
• Research & Development Expense in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ERDS]
• Labor & Related Expenses in Research & Development [ELRD]
• Research & Development in Cost of Revenue [ERDC]
• Research & Development Expense - Gross (before Government Grants)

Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other - Total [SSGO] represents selling, general and administrative costs, not related to labor, research and development,  depreciation/amortization/impairment in SGA expenses. Applicable to all Industries.
Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other - Total [SSGO] includes:
• Advertising Expense [SADE]
• Property & Other Taxes [SPTX]
• Rental Expense [SRXP]
• Occupancy Expense - Other [SOEO]
• Pre-Opening Expenses [SPOE] (applicable only Industrial)
• Provision for Doubtful Accounts & Write-off [SPDW]  (Applicable only Industrial)
• Equipment/Occupancy Expense - Bank/Financial - Other [SEOE]

In the absence of the breakdown above for Industrial companies, it includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other [ESGO].

In the absence of the breakdown above for Property, Bank ,Investment Trust, Other Financial companies, it includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other [ESGO] 
• Research & Development Expense [ERAD]
• Research & Development Expense in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ERDS]
• Rental Expenses in Research & Development Expense [ERRD]
• Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total [ETRD]
• Research & Development Expense - Capitalized [ECRD]
• Research & Development in Cost of Revenue [ERDC]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Research & Development Expense [ESCR]
• Research & Development Expense - Gross (before Government Grants) [ERBG]
• Bad Debt Written-Off/Provision [EBDW]

Insurance:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other [ESGO]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Research & Development Expense [ESCR]
• Bad Debt Written-Off/Provision [EBDW]
• Provision for Loan Losses [ELOP]
• Equipment/Occupancy Expense - Bank/Financial - Other [EOEO]

Advertising Expense [SADE] represents a company’s cost of advertising media and promotional expenses. Applicable to all industries. 
Advertising Expenses [SADE] includes: 
• Advertising Expense [EADV]

Operating Expenses - Total [SOET] represents total operating expense as reported by the company. This item needs to be captured in a cost-by-nature or single-step income statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Operating Expenses - Total [SOET] includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Total [SSGA]
• Other Operating Expense/Income - Net [SOIE]

Industrial and Property companies additionally includes:
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Insurance Claims/Reserves - Total [STIC]
• Dividends to Policy Holders [SDPH]
• Fees & Commissions Expense [SCFE]
• Underwriting Expenses [SUWE]
• Expenses from Banking Operations - Insurance [SEBO]

Banks additionally includes:
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]

Investment additionally includes:
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]
• Operating Expenses - Revenue Account [SOER]
• Operating Expenses - Capital Account [SOEC]

Financial companies additionally includes:
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Operating Expenses - Total [XTOE]
• Total Expenses [XEXP]
• Bank Operating Expenses - Total [XBOE]

Operating Profit before Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) [SOPR] represents the as reported total operating income (revenues and operating income less operating costs) from a company’s primary/core operations, before non-recurring and non-operating items. Applicable to all industries.
Operating Profit before Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) [SOPR] includes:
• Revenue from Business Activities - Total[STLR]
• Less: Operating Expenses - Total[SOET]

In the absence of the above breakdown it includes:
• Operating Profit/Income from Operations[XEBT]

Financing Income/(Expense) - Net - Total [SFIE] represents the total value of income and expenses related to financial operations. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies. 
Financing Income/(Expense) - Net - Total [SFIE] includes:
• Non-Interest Financial Income/Expense - Total [SNIF]
• Interest Expense - Net of Interest Income [SNII] (deducted)

Financial companies additionally includes:
• Interest Expense - Finance - Total [SIET] (deducted)

If the above accounts are not available, it will be the sum of the following items:
• Net Financing Income/Expense [XNFI]
• Financial Expense - Total [XTFE] (deducted)
• Financial Income - Total [XTFI]

Interest Expense - Net of (Interest Income) [SNII] represents net interest income and expenses when not shown separately. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies.
Interest Expense - Net of (Interest Income) [SNII] includes:
• Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN]
• Interest Income - Non-Bank [SINI] (deducted)

Non-Interest Financial Income/(Expense) - Total [SNIF] represents the total value of non-interest expense. It includes realized and unrealized gains and losses recorded as a result of foreign exchange fluctuations, gains and losses on the sale of investments, dividend income and accretion of the costs that an extraction company will incur in the future, for the closure of a mine and restoring the natural environment to its previous shape. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies.
Non-Interest Financial Income/(Expense) - Total [SNIF] includes:
• Non-Interest Financial Income/Expense - Total [EINU]
• Dividend & Investment Income [SIDN]
• Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss - Non-Business [SIFX]
• Amortization of Deferred Financing Charges [SADF] (deducted)
• Sale of Investments Held for Sale, Maturity & Trading - Gain/Loss [SGIT]
• Non-Interest Financial Income/Expense - Other - Net [SINO]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Accretion - Site Closure & Reclamation Expenses [SSCR] (deducted)

Foreign Exchange Gain/(Loss) - Non-Business [SIFX] represents the net result on foreign currency exchange. Applicable to Industrial, Insurance, Property, Investment and Financial companies. 
Foreign Exchange Gain/(Loss) - Non-Business [SIFX] includes:
• Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss - Non-Business [EIFX]

Other Non-Operating Income/(Expense) - Total [SNEI] represents other net non-operating income or expenses. Applicable to all industries.
Other Non-Operating Income/(Expense) - Total [SNEI] includes:
• Non-Operating Rental Income [SRNI]
• Transfer to/from Untaxed Reserves [STRF]
• Trading Derivatives - Gain/Loss [SNDT]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Effective Gain/Loss [SNDE]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/Loss [SNDR]

• Supplementary Adjustments - Non-Operating [SSPN]

• Other Non-Operating Income/Expense [EONO]

Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX] represents pre-tax profit without the effect of unusual and extraordinary income/expense. Applicable to all Industries.
Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX] includes:
• Operating Profit before Non-Recurring Income/Expense [SOPR]
• Sale of Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets - Gain/Loss [SFAS]
• Equity Earnings - before Taxes including Non-Recurring [SIQA]
• Other Non-Operating Income/Expense - Total [SNEI]

Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies additionally includes:
• Financing Income/Expense - Net - Total [SFIE]

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss - Non-Business [SIFX]
• Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN] (deducted)

Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN] represents the total value of non-recurring income or expenses. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN] includes:
• Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Other - Total [SGLO]

• Compensation for Disaster - Pre-Tax [SDCX]
• Sale & Acquisition of Group Companies - Gain/Loss [SDSA]
• Fair Value Adjustments - Investment Property [SIPV]
• Other than Temporary Impairment Losses on Investments [SIMP] (Deducted)
• Impairment - Investment Property [SIIN] (Deducted)
• Impairment - Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets [SITI] (Deducted)
• Recognition of Negative Goodwill [SNGO]
• Early Extinguishment of Lease Related Debts - Gain/Loss [SERD]
• Restructuring Charges [SRST] (Deducted)
• Litigation Expenses/Settlements [SLIT] (Deducted)
• COVID-19 Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Total [SCVT]
• Impairment - Financial Investments [SIVO] (Deducted)
• Impairment - Deferred Costs [SIDC] (Deducted)
• Fair Value Adjustments - Investment Property [SIPV]
• Fair Value Adjustments - Financial Investments [SFVI]
• Fair Value Adjustments - Other Assets [SFVO]

Industrial and Property companies additionally includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/Loss [SDHN]
• Early Termination of Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/Loss [SDET]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Ineffective Gain/Loss [SDIE]
• Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging [SDUA]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Research & Development - in Process [SRDW]
• Valuation of Inventory - Gain/(Loss) [SVAI]
• Fair Value Adjustments - Biological Assets [SFVB]
• Special Income - Total [XSPI]
• Special Expense - Total [XSPE]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Write-Off of Real Estate Held for Sale [SWRS] (Deducted)
• Property-Related Acquisition Expenses [SPAE] (Deducted)

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Exceptional Claims & Benefits Paid (Catastrophes) [SETR] (Deducted)

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Non-Recurring Income/Expense [ENRE].

Impairment - Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets [SITI] represents the total value of impairment of all assets.  It includes a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value write-down of long-lived assets or assets held for use, company acquisition costs (goodwill), other intangible assets and oil and natural gas assets. Applicable to all Industries.
Impairment - Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets [SITI] includes:
• Impairment - Fixed Assets [SIFO]
• Impairment - Goodwill [SIGO]
• Impairment - Intangibles excluding Goodwill [SIIO]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Impairment - Oil & Gas Assets [SIOG]

Impairment - Fixed Assets [SIFO] represents a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value write-down of long-lived assets or assets held for use. These assets are retained by the reporting company. This item is applicable to all industries and may also be reported as part of the business and geographic segment information.
Impairment - Fixed Assets [SIFO] includes:
• Impairment - Fixed Assets [EIFO]

Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Other - Total [SGLO] represents other non-recurring income or losses, not included in any specific non-recurring categories. It includes as well transfers to/from untaxed reserves. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Other - Total [SGLO] includes:
• Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Other [EGLO]

Income before Taxes [SIBT] represents as reported income/loss after all operating and non-operating income and expense before the deduction of income tax. Applicable to all industries.
Income before Taxes [SIBT] includes:
• Net Income before Tax [XIBT]
Include if the below items are reported after Pretax Income:
• Amortization of Goodwill [EAMA]
• Impairment - Goodwill [EIGO]
• Labor & Related Expenses in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ELAS]
• Management Remuneration [EMEN]
• Workers' Profits Participation & Welfare Funds [EWPF]
• Property & Other Taxes [EPOT]

Exclude below items if reported as pretax items:
• Equity Earnings - Net of Tax [CEIA]
• Wealth Taxes [CTWT]
• Minority Interest - Continuing Operations [CMIN]
• Final Tax [FTAX]
• Research & Development Expense - Tax Credit [ERTC]

In the absence of Net Income before Tax [XIBT], it includes:
• Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX]
• Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Total [SGLN]

Income Taxes [STAX] represents total income taxes for the period. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes [STAX] includes:
• Provision for Income Tax – Unclassified [SPAX]
• Income Taxes for the Year - Current [SCTX]
• Income Taxes - Deferred [SDTR]
• Income Taxes - Other (by Type) [SOTX]
• Provision for Income Tax Expense- Unclassified [SPRX]

Investment companies additionally includes:
• Taxes on Capital Account [STCX]
• Taxes on Revenue Account [STRX]

In the absence of above, it includes:
Income Taxes - Total [XTAX]

Income Taxes for the Year - Current [SCTX] When a company reports its total current taxes without any delineation (no breakdown reported) between tax jurisdictions. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial Statements. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes for the Year - Current [SCTX] includes:
• Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [SCID]
• Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [SCIF]
• Income Taxes - Other (KFAS/NLST) - Current [SCTO]

If the accounts above are not available, Income Taxes - Total - Current [VCTR] is taken.

Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [SCID] reflects the portion of a company’s current income tax provision attributable to its domestic and local tax jurisdiction. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [SCID] includes:
• Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [VCTD]
• Income Taxes - Local - Current [VCTL]

Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [SCIF] reflects the portion of a company’s current income tax provision attributable to non-domestic tax jurisdictions. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [SCIF] includes:
• Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [VCTF]

Income Taxes - Deferred [SDTR] represents a company's total deferred taxes reported without any delineation (no breakout) between tax jurisdictions, this amount is classified as Deferred Tax – Total (VDTR). This value is obtained from the notes of the financial Statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Deferred [SDTR] includes:   
• Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [SDID]
• Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [SDIF]
• Income Taxes - Other - Deferred [SDTO]

If the accounts above are not available, Income Taxes - Total - Deferred [VDTR] is taken.

Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [SDID] reflects the portion of a company’s deferred income tax provision attributable to its domestic and local tax jurisdiction. Applicable to all Industries. Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [SDID] includes:
• Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [VDTD]
• Income Taxes - Local - Deferred [VDTL]

Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [SDIF] reflects the portion of a company’s deferred income tax provision attributable to non-domestic tax jurisdictions. Deferred tax provisions are established to account for changes in deferred tax asset and liability accounts within a given period. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [SDIF] includes:
• Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [VDTF]

Net Income after Tax [SIAT] represents the income/expense after all operating and non-operating income and expense, reserves, income taxes, but before equity in earnings, minority interest, extraordinary items, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations and preferred dividends. Applicable to all Industries.
Net Income after Tax [SIAT] includes:
• Income before Taxes [SIBT]
• Income Taxes [STAX}

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Net Income after Tax [XIAT]

Other Comprehensive Income - Starting Line [SOCS] represents the net income reported by the company as the starting line in the other comprehensive income section. This line item needs to be collected irrespective of the fact whether the company reports it or not. If the starting line net income is not reported under the OCI, then we are supposed to pick the bottomline net income from Income Statement as the Net Income Starting line for OCI. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Starting Line [SOCS] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Starting Line [XOCS]

Other Comprehensive Income - Foreign Currency [SCFN] includes other comprehensive income/losses arising from foreign currency differences which has not been accounted for in the income statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Foreign Currency [SCFN] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Foreign Currency - Net of Tax [XCFN]

Other Comprehensive Income - Net of Tax - Total [SCOP] represents the sum of all items which have not been accounted for in the income statement.  Other Comprehensive Income - Net of Tax - Total [SCOP]  should not be confused with total comprehensive income which also comprises all income statement items. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Net of Tax - Total [SCOP] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Net of Tax - Total [XCIN]

If the account above is not available, it includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Foreign Currency [SCFN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Unrealized Investment Gain/Loss [SCGL]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Hedging Gain/Loss [SCHN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Revaluation of Tangible & Intangible Assets [SCRN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Other [SCOI]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Unearned Income [SCUN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Discontinued Operations [SCDN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Associated Companies [SCAN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Pension Related [SCPP]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Income Tax [SITC]

Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB] represents  the sum of all income statement and other comprehensive income items, before the exclusion of minority interests. Applicable to all Industries.
Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB] includes:
• Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [XCIB]

If the account above is not available, it includes Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [XCIB].

Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Parent Company Equity Holders - Total [SCIE] represents the sum of all income statement and other comprehensive income items before the exclusion of minority interests less the value of minority interest reported as part of total comprehensive income. Applicable to all Industries.
Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Parent Company Equity Holders - Total [SCIE] includes:
• Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Owners of Parent Company - Total [XCIE]

In the absence of above, it includes: 
• Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB]
• Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Minority Interest - Total [SCIM] (deducted)
• Comprehensive Income - Dividend on Preferred Stock [SDCI] (deducted).

DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Period End Date [SPPSGI] represents dividends per common share before taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which a company reports its business activity at the end of a financial period. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Period End Date [SPPSGI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Gross - Issue Specific [XDPSGI]

Allocated Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [BINCI] represents basic net income allocated to a particular share issue. Applicable to all industries.
Allocated Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [BINCI] includes:
• Allocated Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [XBINCI]

Earnings Allocation Factor - Basic - Issue Specific [BEAFI] represents factor used to allocate part of company-level earnings per share to a specific share issue/instrument. Applicable to all industries.
Earnings Allocation Factor - Basic - Issue Specific [BEAFI] includes:
• Earnings Allocation Factor - Issue Specific [XBEAFI]

Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI] represents the weighted average common shares outstanding used to calculate earnings and other per share items, per specific share issue. Applicable to all Industries.
Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI] includes:
• Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [BWASI]

Comprehensive Earnings Per Share - Basic - Issue Specific [SCBEI] represents the value of the sum of all income statement and other comprehensive income items (Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Parent Company Equity Holders - Total [SCIE]) divided by weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item. To be used at instrument level. (Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI]). Applicable to all Industries.

It uses Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB] as numerator if the account above is not available.

Dilution Adjustment [SCDAJ] represents the adjustments is used to calculate Diluted EPS. Applicable to all industries. 
Dilution Adjustment [SCDAJ] includes:
• Dilution Adjustment [CDAJ]

Allocated Diluted Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DINNCI] represents diluted net income allocated to a specific share issue. Applicable to all industries.
Allocated Diluted Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DINNCI] includes:
• Allocated Diluted Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [XDINCI]

Earnings Allocation Factor - Diluted - Issue Specific [DEAFI] represents the proportion of each share issue to the total profits of the company. It is being collected on the instrument level only for basic and diluted shares. This item is commonly not reported and in that case will be derived. For companies with single issue, Earnings Allocation Factor - Diluted - Issue Specific [DEAFI] is always equal to one. For companies with multiple issues, it is generally calculated as the number of weighted average shares of an issue divided by the combined weighted average shares of all the issues. The weighted shares used already take into account the ratio used to convert the secondary class of shares to primary equivalent. Applicable to all industries. 
Earnings Allocation Factor - Diluted - Issue Specific [DEAFI] includes:
• Diluted Earnings Allocation Factor - Issue Specific [XDEAFI]

Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific [SDWSI] represents diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item. To be used at instrument level. Applicable to all Industries.
Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific [SDWSI] includes:
• Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific [DWASI]

Comprehensive Earnings Per Share - Diluted - Issue Specific [SCDEI] represents the value of the sum of all income statement and other comprehensive income items (Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Parent Company Equity Holders - Total [SCIE]) divided by diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item (Shares used to calculate EPS - Diluted - Issue Specific [SDWSI]). Applicable to all Industries.

It uses Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB] as numerator if the account above is not available.

DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSGI] represents dividends per common share before taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which a company announces its intention to pay dividends to its shareholders. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSGI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Gross - Issue Specific [XDPSGI]

DPS - Common - Net - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSNI] represents dividends per common share after taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which a company announces its intention to pay dividends to its shareholders. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Common - Net - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSNI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Net - Issue Specific [XDPSNI]

Earnings before Interest & Taxes (EBIT) [SEBIT] represents a difference between total revenues reported by the company (Revenue from Business Activities - Total [STLR]) and total operating expense as reported by the company (Operating Expenses - Total [SOET]).
In the absence of the above, it includes: 
• Income before Taxes [SIBT] 
• Financing Income/(Expense) - Net - Total [SFIE] (less)
• Sale of Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets - Gain/(Loss) [SFAS] (less) 
• Equity Earnings/(Loss) - before Taxes including Non-Recurring [SIQA]  (less)
• Other Non-Operating Income/(Expense) - Total [SNEI] (less)
• Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Total [SGLN] (less)
Applicable to all Industries.

Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) [SEBITDA] represents a sum of Earnings before Interest and Taxes [SEBIT] and the total depreciation and amortization value for the period [STDAE]. Applicable to all Industries.

Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) and Operating Lease Payments [SEBITDAL] represents Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation & amortization and Operating leases. Applicable to all Industries.
Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) and Operating Lease Payments [SEBITDAL] includes:
• Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA)[SEBITDA]
• Rental/Operating Lease Expense [SROL]

Amortization - Total - Supplemental [SAMR] represents the accounting process of allocating the cost of assets that lack physical existence over those periods expected to benefit from the use of these assets. These assets usually have a high degree of uncertainty concerning future benefits. This field represents total amortization value for the period, related to assets classified in the balance sheet as intangibles. Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization - Total - Supplemental [SAMR] includes:
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill - Supplemental [VAMI]

If account above is not available, it includes:
• Goodwill Amortization - Supplemental [SAMA]
• Intangible Amortization - Other - Supplemental [SAOI]
• Amortization of Deferred Costs - Supplemental [SADC]

Intangible Amortization - Other - Supplemental [SAOI] represents the accounting process of allocating the cost of assets that lack physical existence over those periods expected to benefit from the use of these assets. These assets usually have a high degree of uncertainty concerning future benefits. Applicable to all Industries.
Intangible Amortization - Other - Supplemental [SAOI] includes:
• Amortization of Other Intangibles excluding Goodwill - Supplemental [VAOI]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs - Supplemental [SAML]
• Amortization of Computer Software - Supplemental [SASW]
• Amortization of Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Supplemental [SAMB]
• Amortization of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets - Supplemental [SALR]
• Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development Expenses - Supplemental [SARD]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Amortization of Below/Above Market Leases - Supplemental [SAAM]
• Amortization of Tenant Relationships & In Place Leases - Supplemental [SATR]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes:
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill [EAMI]
• Amortization of Intangibles excluding Goodwill [EAMO]
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAMC]
• Amortization & Impairment of Intangibles including Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAIC]
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EAMS]

Depreciation, Depletion & Amortization - Total [STDAE] represents the maximum value of combined depreciation and amortization reported by the company in the income statement, cash flow or notes. Applicable to all industries.
Depreciation, Depletion & Amortization - Total [STDAE] includes:
• Depreciation - Total[STDEP]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges - Total [STAMD]
• Amortization of Intangible Assets including Goodwill - Total [STAMI]

In the absence of Amortization of Intangible Assets including Goodwill - Total [STAMI], it includes:
• Amortization of Intangible Assets excluding Goodwill - Total [STAMO]
• Amortization of Goodwill - Total [STAMA]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Depreciation & Amortization - Total [TDAE] 
• Amortization of Deferred Charges - Total [TAMD].

Amortization of Intangible Assets excluding Goodwill - Total [STAMO] represents the maximum value of amortization related to intangible assets other than goodwill reported by the company in the income statement, cash flow or notes.
 will be used in the calculation of ratios and analytics such as Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA). Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization of Intangible Assets excluding Goodwill - Total [STAMO] includes:
• Amortization of Intangible Assets excluding Goodwill - Total [TAMO]

Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total - Supplemental [SXRD] represents the total research and development expenditure, including the portion of R&D costs that was capitalized to intangible or tangible assets during the accounting period. This is collected when reported in notes and which cannot be directly or indirectly associated to the face item of Income Statement. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total - Supplemental [SXRD] includes:
• Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total - Supplemental [VRDT]

If the account above is not available, it includes Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total [ETRD].

• Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [SRDE]
• Research & Development Expense - Capitalized - Supplemental [SRDC]

If the item above is still not available, it includes:
• Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [SRDE]
• Research & Development Expense - Capitalized - Supplemental [SRDC]

Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [SRDE] represents expenses for the research and development of new products and services, excluding the portion of R&D expenses that was capitalized to intangible or tangible assets during the accounting period. This is picked when the R&D expense is reported in notes and the company does not specify where it is included. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [SRDE] includes:
• Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [VRAD]
• Research & Development Expense - Gross (before Government Grants) - Supplemental [VRBG]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Research & Development Expense [SRAD].

Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Net of Tax - Supplemental [SVSCN] represents the provisions for Stock Option compensation which is reported in the footnotes after the tax impact of stock-based compensation. Applicable to all Industries.
Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Net of Tax - Supplemental [SVSCN] is the difference between: 
• Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [SVSCP]
• Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [SVSCT]

Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [SVSCP] represents the provisions for Stock Option compensation when reflected in the footnotes before the tax impact of stock-based compensation. This would apply to the nominal charge recognized by some companies or the fair value provision for companies who have adopted the accounting standard. Applicable to all Industries.
Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [SVSCP] includes:
• Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [VSCP]

Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [SVSCT] represents tax benefits relating to Stock option compensation. Applicable to all Industries.
Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [SVSCT] includes:
• Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [VSCT]

If the account above is not available, it is calculated by multiplying Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [VSCP] by Estimated Tax Value [SETAXV].

Normalized after Tax Profit [SNAT] represents the value of income/expense after all operating and non-operating income and expense, reserves, income taxes, but before equity in earnings, minority interest, extraordinary items, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations and preferred dividends (Net Income after Tax [SIAT]) deducted by the total value of non-recurring income or expenses (Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN]). Applicable to all Industries.

Earnings before Interest & Taxes (EBIT) - Normalized [SNEBIT] represents pre-tax profit without the effect of unusual or extraordinary income/expense and interest expense. Applicable to all Industries.
Earnings before Interest & Taxes (EBIT) - Normalized [SNEBIT] includes: 
• Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX]
• Interest Expense - Net of Interest Income [SNII]

Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) - Normalized [SNEBITDA] represents pre-tax profit without the effect of unusual/extraordinary income/expense, interest expense and depreciation & amortization. Applicable to all Industries.
Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) - Normalized [SNEBITDA] is Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX] less Interest Expense - Net of Interest Income [SNII] less Depreciation, Depletion & Amortization - Total [STDAE].

Income before Taxes & Provision for Loan Losses [SIBTLLP] represents the value of as reported income/loss after all operating and non-operating income and expense, before the deduction of income tax adjusted by the value of provisions established for possible defaults or renegotiations by customers on loans from a financial institution. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Income before Taxes & Provision for Loan Losses [SIBTLLP] includes:
• Income before Taxes [SIBT]
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]

Rental/Operating Lease Expense [SROL] represents rental expenses paid for offices, factories, machinery and equipment. It includes rent for the operating leasing machinery/equipment. Applicable to all Industries.
Rental/Operating Lease Expense [SROL] includes:
• Rental Expense - Supplemental [VRXP]

If account above is not available, it will be the sum of the following items:
• Rental Expense [ERXP]
• Aircraft Operating Lease Costs [EAOL]
• Ground leases/Rental Expenses in Cost of Revenues [EREX]
• Rental Expenses in Research & Development Expense [ERRD]

Advertising Expenses - Supplemental [SADV] represents a company’s cost of advertising media and promotional expenses reported as a supplemental value. Applicable to all industries.
Advertising Expense - Supplemental [SADV] includes:
• Advertising Expenses - Supplemental [VADV] 

If the account above is not available, it includes Advertising Expense [EADV].

Cost of Revenue including Operation & Maintenance (Utility) - Total [SCREV] represents the total cost of manufacturing and distributing goods and facilities by utility companies.
